description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs, including functions for data projection, grouping, and formatting, as well as index management for the 'llm_costs' collection in MongoDB.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB aggregation projection stage to normalize and extract relevant fields from the llm_costs collection.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to the aggregation pipeline, converting string dates to Date objects.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects specific fields and formats the date as 'YYYY-MM-DD' for grouping.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Aggregates agent data to compute total costs and organize costs and tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level data with formatted costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Groups data at the project level, aggregating agent data.

methods.name: projectProjectStage
methods.description: Projects project-level data with total cost and agents.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Groups data at the user level, summing project costs and listing projects.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Final projection to structure the user-level hierarchical data with total user cost.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function to perform the aggregation pipeline, returning formatted hierarchical cost data per user.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the 'llm_costs' collection to optimize query performance.
